settings.negative_description: No background, no text, no UI, no photorealism, no anime, no modern clothes, no weapons, no shield, clean silhouette

snes.label: SNES RPG (FF6 / Chrono Trigger)
snes.prefix: Pixel art, SNES 16-bit RPG style. Chunky readable pixels, large head proportions (40% height), colorful vibrant palette.

gba.label: GBA RPG (Fire Emblem / Golden Sun)
gba.prefix: Pixel art, GBA-era RPG style. Slightly more proportional body, finer detail, defined features, rich but controlled palette.

modern.label: Modern Pixel Art (Celeste / Dead Cells)
modern.prefix: Modern pixel art style. Clean lines, smooth shading, detailed character design, contemporary indie game aesthetic.

chibi.label: Chibi/SD (Super Deformed)
chibi.prefix: Pixel art, chibi super-deformed style. Very large head (50% height), tiny cute body, expressive features, vibrant colors.

style_anchor.description: A heroic fantasy adventurer character sprite, 3/4 front-facing view. Simple brown tunic and leather boots. Warm skin tones. Clean readable silhouette at 32x32 pixels. Neutral standing pose.
style_anchor.note: Generated first, used as style_image for all subsequent characters to ensure visual consistency

characters.description: A male dragonkin character sprite, full body from head to feet visible, 3/4 front-facing. Draconic dragon head with red scales, pronounced brow ridges, small dark horns curving back, strong jaw, slit-pupil orange eyes. Humanoid bipedal body standing upright, wearing simple dark red-brown tunic with ember-orange trim and boots. Powerful neutral stance.
characters.color_hints: red-scaled skin, dark horns, orange eyes, dark red tunic, ember trim

characters.description: A female dragonkin character sprite, full body from head to feet visible, 3/4 front-facing. Humanoid bipedal body standing upright, wearing simple dark red-brown tunic with ember-orange trim and boots. Poised neutral stance.
